query:
SELECT
                        id,
                        title,
                        description,
                        priority::text   AS "priority!",
                        status::text     AS "status!",
                        due_date,
                        project_id,
                        created_at,
                        updated_at
                    FROM tasks
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                      AND (title ILIKE $2 OR description ILIKE $2)
                    ORDER BY
                        -- exact prefix first, then trigram rank via updated_at as tiebreak
                        (title ILIKE $3) DESC,
                        updated_at DESC
                    LIMIT $4
